01001.name: Eagle Eye
01001.text: Scout 3 path cards, then draw 1 path card.

01002.name: Paths We've Roamed Before
01002.text: Choose up to 4 total moments or attributes from any number of Ranger discards. Place the chosen cards facedown on the top of their Ranger's fatigue stack.

01003.name: Strider
01003.text: You can only commit this attribute when interacting with a trail.

01004.name: Trail Mix
01004.text: Exhaust (use 1 morsel): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of FIT in their energy pool.

01005.name: Reverb Locket
01005.text: When you play this gear, attach a moment to it from your hand. Exhaust (use 1 echo): Play the attached moment as if it were in your hand. It remains attached to this gear instead of being discarded.

01006.name: Perfect Recall
01006.text: Play a moment from your discard pile without paying its energy cost (X is equal to the chosen moment's cost). This card can be played at the time specified on the chosen moment.

01007.name: Adaptable Multitool
01007.text: Exhaust (use 1 charge): Spend 1 energy to gain 1 energy of any type.

01008.name: Ironwool Boots
01008.text: Unique. Response: After you play a moment, soothe 1 fatigue.

01009.name: Meditation Pillow
01009.text: FOC + [connection] (use 1 session): Meditate on your journey to shuffle a number of cards from your fatigue stack into your Ranger deck equal to your effort.

01010.name: The Right Tool
01010.text: Choose a ranger. That ranger may discard one of their equipped gear to search their ranger deck for a gear and equip it without paying its energy cost.

01011.name: Pocketed Belt Pouch
01011.text: Reduce the equip value of your gear by 1 (to a minimum of 1). AWA + [reason] use 1 pocket: Open your belt pouch and reach inside to search your Ranger deck for a gear and add it to your hand.

01012.name: Universal Power Cells
01012.text: Attach to a Ranger's equipped tech. When you play this attachment, add 3 tokens to the attached gear. Response: When this card becomes unattached, discard 3 tokens from the attached gear.

01013.name: Functional Replica
01013.text: Exhaust (use 1 charge): Choose a Ranger's equipped gear. Resolve the chosen gear's effect as if you had used a token from it and/or exhausted it.

01014.name: The Mother of Invention
01014.text: Choose an attachment in a Ranger's discard. That Ranger may immediately play that attachment as if it were in their hand.

01015.name: Moment of Desperation
01015.text: Discard one of your equipped gear to add [harm] to a being equal to the number of tokens on the discarded gear.

01016.name: Masterwork
01016.text: Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear. Response: When a Ranger performs a test from the attached gear, commit 1 effort.

01017.name: Favorite Gear
01017.text: Attach to one of your equipped gear. Response: After you use a token from the attached gear, soothe 1 fatigue.

01018.name: Energized Hiking Greaves
01018.text: Use X buffers: When you perform a test, suffer X fewer fatigue from each card between you and the card with which you are interacting.

01019.name: One Eye Open
01019.text: Response: When you rest, exhaust up to one being for each AWA in your energy pool.

01020.name: Riri the Sparrow Hawk
01020.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Add 1 [harm] to a being within reach. AWA + [reason]: Survey the way ahead to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.

01021.name: A Gentle Nudge
01021.text: Each Ranger may discard 1 [progress] from a being within reach of them to move that being.

01022.name: Homeward Bound
01022.text: Move all [progress] from a being to a feature.

01023.name: Paratrepsis Whistle
01023.text: Exhaust (use 1 call): When a Ranger would suffer an injury by a predator or [harm] would be added to a being, cancel that effect.

01024.name: A Deeper Understanding
01024.text: Choose a being. Move [progress] from the chosen being to each other card in play, up to 1 [progress] per card.

01025.name: Healing Touch
01025.text: Choose one: Discard 1 [harm] from a being to add 3 [progress] to it. Heal 1 injury from a Ranger.

01026.name: Calming Presence
01026.text: Attach to a predator. Attached card loses the predator trait. Response: Before a challenge effect on the attached card would resolve, you may discard 2 [progress] from it to cancel the effect.

01027.name: Oru the Sheep Dog
01027.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Move a being and add 2 [progress] to it. FIT + [connection]: Pet your canine companion to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.

01028.name: Green Thumb
01028.text: Search the path deck and discard for a flora and put it into play with this skill attached. Increase the attached flora's [herm] threshold by 2.

01029.name: Local Fare
01029.text: Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they may add 1 [harm] to a flora to dodge each being in the same area as that flora.

01030.name: Puffercrawler Spores
01030.text: Attach to any Ranger's equipped gear. Response: When you add [harm] to a being with the attached gear, exhaust that being and attach this card to it. The attached being gains the flora trait.

01031.name: Familiar Ground
01031.text: Add 1 [harm] to a flora to add 3 [progress] to a trail.

01032.name: Carbonforged Trowel
01032.text: SPI + [reason]: Tend to the local plants to add or remove [harm] from a flora equal to your effort. FIT + [conflict]: Strike [2] out with your gardening tool to add 1 [harm] to a being for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.

01033.name: Secret Garden
01033.text: Attach to a feature. Attached feature gains the flora trait.

01034.name: Loose-Leaf Tea Kit
01034.text: Response: After you add 1 or more [harm] to a flora, you may add 1 herb to this gear. Exhaust (use 1 herb): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger gains 1 energy of any type.

01035.name: Nature's Abundance
01035.text: Each Ranger may add 1 [harm] to a flora to soothe 1 fatigue and gain 1 energy of any type. When you add [harm] to a flora in this way, you may not exceed its [harm] threshold.

01036.name: Static Sifter
01036.text: Response: After you add 1 or more [harm] to a flora, you may add 1 vittle to this gear. Exhaust (use 1 vittle): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes 2 fatigue.

01037.name: Undaunted Seeker
01037.text: Exhaust (use 1 morsel): When you perform a test, dodge 1 card.

01038.name: Peerless Pathfinder
01038.text: Exhaust: Move your [ranger] to a feature. That feature fatigues you.

01039.name: A Leaf in the Breeze
01039.text: Response: When you Traverse, dodge up to 3 cards.

01040.name: Hydrolens Goggles
01040.text: AWA + [reason] (use 1 drop): Clarify your view of the environment around you to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.

01041.name: Share in the Valley's Secrets
01041.text: Exhaust each obstacle. Suffer fatigue equal to the number of obstacles exhausted this way.

01042.name: Boundary Sensor
01042.text: Exhaust (use 1 sensor): When a Ranger performs a Traverse test, commit 1 effort.

01043.name: Orlin Hiking Stave
01043.text: Exhaust (use 1 stride): Add 1 [progress] to a trail. FIT + [conflict]: Strike [2] out with your walking implement to add 1 [harm] to a being for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.

01044.name: Afforded by Nature
01044.text: Discard any number of [progress] from a trail to add an equal number of [harm] to a being.

01045.name: Phonoscopic Headset
01045.text: Exhaust: When a Ranger scouts, increase the number of cards scouted by 1.

01046.name: Field Journal
01046.text: Response When you rest, add entries equal to the number of FOC in your energy pool. Use 1 entry: When a Ranger interacts with a feature, commit 1 effort.

01047.name: Hidden Trail
01047.text: Response: When you travel, if this trail is attached to the location, travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck. Clear [progress]: Attach this trail to the location.

01048.name: Walk With Me
01048.text: Response: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add [progress] to a being equal to your effort. This is in addition to the test's standard effect.

01049.name: Breathe Into It
01049.text: Response: When you perform a test, discard any number of cards from your fatigue stack to commit 1 effort to that test for every 2 cards discarded this way.

01050.name: Cradled by the Earth
01050.text: Choose a trail. Soothe fatigue equal to the number of  on that trail. This fatigue may be divided as you choose between all Rangers.

01052.name: Exceptional Tinkerer
01052.text: Exhaust: Spend 1 energy to add 1 token to a tech.

01053.name: Ferinodex
01053.text: Exhaust (use 1 profile): When a Ranger performs an Avoid test, commit 1 effort.

01054.name: Carbonforged Cable
01054.text: Attach to a predator. Use 1 length: When the attached predator would ready, it remains exhausted. FIT + [conflict] : Lead the animal to move the attached predator.

01055.name: Dayhowler
01055.text: Discard this gear from play to exhaust beings equal to the number of charges on this gear. Response: After you succeed at an Avoid test, add 1 charge to this gear.

01056.name: Trail Markers
01056.text: Attach to a location or feature. The attached card gains the trail trait. Response: When 1 or more [progress] is added to the attached trail, increase the number of [progress] added by 1.

01057.name: Spiderpad Gloves
01057.text: During your turn, you may treat obstacles as if they did not have the obstacle keyword. FIT + [reason] (use 1 charge): Climb the obstructing terrain with the agility of a spider to move your [ranger] to an obstacle.

01058.name: Wrist-mounted Darter
01058.text: FOC + [conflict] (use 1 dart): Shoot one of the featherlight darts to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. Whether you succeed or fail, dodge all cards between you and that being.

01059.name: Infusion Canteen
01059.text: When you play this gear, choose an aspect (you may place a spare energy token here as a reminder). Exhaust (use 1 sip): Gain 1 energy matching the chosen aspect.

01060.name: Memorill Sketchpad
01060.text: Response: After a path card is cleared, add 1 inkrill to this gear. Use 1 inkrill: When a Ranger interacts with a feature, commit 1 effort.

01061.name: Memlev Trekking Poles
01061.text: Exhaust (use 1 charge): When you perform a Traverse test, use FOC instead of FIT.

01062.name: A Stone in the River
01062.text: Response: After you succeed at an Avoid test, exhaust 1 additional being.

01063.name: Camoweave Cloak
01063.text: Use 1 charge: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue from a path card, reduce the fatigue suffered to 0.

01064.name: Thoroughly Prepared
01064.text: Response: When a Ranger would suffer 1 or more fatigue, they soothe that amount of fatigue instead.

01065.name: Guardian
01065.text: Exhaust: Reduce a being's presence to 0 until the end of your turn.

01066.name: Voice of the Elders
01066.text: Exhaust: Spend 1 energy to add 1 token to an aid card.

01067.name: Surveyed Land
01067.text: Attach to a feature. Reduce the attached feature's presence by 1 for each marker on this attachment.

01068.name: Tranquilisnare
01068.text: Attach to a being. Reduce the attached being's presence by 1 for each snare on this attachment.

01069.name: One With Nature
01069.text: Reduce the presence of each card in play to 0 until the end of the next turn.

01070.name: Follow in Footsteps
01070.text: Response: After you succeed at a Connect test, add [progress] to a feature equal to your effort. This is in addition to the test's standard effect.

01071.name: Orlin Thumper
01071.text: FIT + [conflict] (use 1 pulse): Strike [2] with a pulse of kinetic energy to add 1 [harm] to a being and exhaust it. If you fail, discard 1 [progress] from that being; if you cannot, it fatigues you instead.

01072.name: Tracked
01072.text: Attach to a being. Response: After a challenge effect on the attached being resolves, add 1 track. Use 1 track: When a Ranger performs a test, commit 1 effort.

01073.name: Intention Translator
01073.text: Exhaust (use 1 charge): When a Ranger performs a Connect test, commit 1 effort.

01074.name: Safeguard
01074.text: Response: When a Ranger would suffer an injury or [harm] would be added to a being, cancel that effect. Suffer 1 injury.

01075.name: Nidocyte Sentinel
01075.text: Attach to a being. Use 1 alarm: When a challenge effect on the attached being would resolve, cancel that effect.

01076.name: Ancestral Teachings
01076.text: Exhaust a being. Then add [progress] to that being equal to the number of exhausted beings within reach.

01077.name: Pokodo the Ferret
01077.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 1 [progress] from this being to add 1 token to an Aid card and 2 [progress] to another being.

01078.name: A Dear Friend
01078.text: Search the path deck and discard for a human and put them into play with this card attached. Response: When the attached human is cleared, move the [progress] from it to any number of other beings, divided as you choose

01080.name: Prodigy of the Floating Tower
01080.text: Exhaust: Choose a manifestation in your discard, and add it to your hand.

01081.name: Root Snare
01081.text: Manifestation. Attach to a feature, and add 2 [progress] to it. Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they may discard 1 or more [progress] from the attached feature to dodge an equal number of cards in the same area.

01082.name: Sky Whip
01082.text: Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) AWA + [conflict]: Strike with a whirling coil of wind and water to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. Then exhaust that being.

01083.name: Stave of the Sun
01083.text: Conduit. Setup. Response: After the challenge deck is shuffled, add 1 glint to this conduit. Exhaust (use X glints): Scout X path cards.

01084.name: What Should Never Be
01084.text: Manifestation. Response: When drawing challenge cards during a test, draw and discard challenge cards until you draw one with a +1 in the used aspect. Use that challenge card for this test, and suffer fatigue equal the number of cards discarded this way.

01085.name: Shape the Earth
01085.text: Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) Add 1 [progress] to each feature and location. Then you may redistribute any number of [progress] between them.

01086.name: Staff of the Wanderer
01086.text: Conduit. Setup. Response: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add 1 stride to this conduit. Exhaust (use X strides): Add X [progress] to a trail.

01087.name: Throng of Life
01087.text: Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) Response: When a Ranger reveals a challenge card during a test, choose which modifier to use from that card. Then choose an additional challenge icon to resolve for this test.

01088.name: Novice Lens
01088.text: Response: After you perform a test in which you committed 1 or more manifestation, gain 1 FOC. Response: When you rest, if you have 1 or more FOC in your energy pool, scout 1 challenge card.

01089.name: Rod of the Clouds
01089.text: Conduit. Setup. Response: Before you draw a challenge card, name a challenge icon; if that icon is on the drawn card, add 1 vision to this conduit. Exhaust (use X visions): Scout X Ranger cards.

01090.name: Harmonize
01090.text: Manifestation. Attach to a being within reach of any Ranger. Response: After a challenge effect on the attached being resolves, the Ranger that played this card gains 1 energy of any type.

01091.name: Seen Through Cycles
01091.text: Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) Choose a being in play, and shuffle it into the path deck. Then search the path deck and discard for a being and put it into play.

01092.name: Scepter of Harmony
01092.text: Conduit. Setup. Response: After you perform a test in which no challenge effects were resolved, add 1 song to this conduit. Exhaust (use X songs): Add X [progress] to a being.

01093.name: Insightful
01093.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

01094.name: Vigilant
01094.text: The number of [conflict] on this attribute is equal to the number of AWA in your energy pool.

01095.name: Perceptive
01095.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, gain 1 AWA.

01097.name: Passionate
01097.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

01098.name: Balanced
01098.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to gain 1 energy of any type.

01099.name: Determined
01099.text: The number of [exploration] on this attribute is equal to the number of FIT in your energy pool.

01101.name: Meticulous
01101.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

01102.name: Versatile
01102.text: Before you commit this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue. If you do, this attribute gains [reason] [exploration] [conflict]

01103.name: Inventive
01103.text: The number of [reason] on this attribute is equal to the number of FOC in your energy pool.

01105.name: Persuasive
01105.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

01106.name: Thoughtful
01106.text: You may commit this attribute to any Ranger's test.

01107.name: Engaging
01107.text: The number of [connection] on this attribute is equal to the number of SPI in your energy pool.

01201.name: Lynx Fur Cloak
01201.text: Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue from a path card, reduce the amount of fatigue suffered to 0.

01202.name: Scuttler Tunnel
01202.text: [FOC] + [EXL]: Navigate the winding tunnel to move your [ranger] to this feature. Response: When you perform a test, if your [ranger] is on this feature, add 1[harm] to it to dodge each card in the same area. Clear [harm]: If your [ranger]is on this feature, suffer 1 injury.

01203.name: Kordo's Instinct
01203.text: Search the path deck for a card and place it on top or bottom of the deck.

01204.name: Sil's Sketchbook
01204.text: Exhaust (use X sketches): Exhaust a path card with presence X. [AWA] + [reason]: Sketch [X] your subject to choose a path card and add X sketches to this book. X is equal to that card's presence.

01205.name: Light As a Feather
01205.text: Manifestation. Choose any number of path cards within reach and shuffle them into the path deck, then draw 1 path card.

01206.name: Kinetic Glass Sculpture
01206.text: Exhaust (use 1 form): Exhaust and move a being.

01207.name: Reclaimer Mucus
01207.text: Attach to a path card. Reduce the attached card's presence by 2. Response: When the attached card fatigues a Ranger, add 1[harm] to it.

01208.name: Topographone
01208.text: [AWA] + [reason] (use 1 graph): Calibrate the device to your current environment to scout 2 path cards for every effort.

01209.name: Quiet
01209.text: Friendly. Persistent. Exhaust: Add 3[harm] to a being and [harm] to Quiet equal to that being's presence.

01210.name: Umbral Claw
01210.text: [FIT] + [conflict] (use 1 rake): Slash [X] with Umbra's claw to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. X is equal to the being's presence. Do not resolve [crest] effects during this test.

01211.name: Ar Tel's Vaulting Rod
01211.text: Exhaust (use 1 vault): Exhaust an obstacle. Response: When there are no vaults on this gear, discard it. [AWA] + [conflict]: Fish [2] if there is a water card in play to soothe 2 fatigue and add 2[progress] to a water card.

01212.name: Gauzeblade
01212.text: [FIT] + [conflict] (use 1 fiber): Slice [X] with the fibrous blade to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. X is equal to the being's presence.

01213.name: Dolewood Canoe
01213.text: Setup. You may travel on river paths. While your [ranger] is on this vehicle, treat the presence of all water features as 1 lower and the presence of all non-water features as 1 higher. [FIT] + [reason]: Board the boat to move your [ranger] to this vehicle or return it to your role.

01214.name: The Kasende Technique
01214.text: If you have a weapon equipped, add 5 [harm] to a being. Then suffer fatigue equal to the number of [harm] on that being in excess of its harm threshold.

01215.name: Touch of the Verdessa
01215.text: Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) Add 1 [harm] to a flora to add 4 [harm] or 4[progress] to a path card. If that path card is a biomeld, increase the number of [harm] or [progress] added to it by 2.

01216.name: Tala's Perseverance
01216.text: Add 3[progress] to a trail. If it's a mountain or obstacle, increase the number of [progress] added by 2.

01217.name: Umbra's Shadow
01217.text: You may move each being. Then resolve a challenge effect on a being of your choice. Resolve this effect even if the being is exhausted.

01218.name: Probability Compass
01218.text: Use 1 needle: When a Ranger reveals a challenge card during a test, choose a modifier from that card. Spend 1 energy matching that modifier's aspect to use it for this test instead.

01219.name: Translocator
01219.text: Exhaust (use 1 shift): When you perform a test, dodge each card in play. If you fail that test, suffer 1 injury.

01220.name: Silaro's Insight
01220.text: Scout 1 path card,1 challenge card, and 1 Ranger card from each Ranger's deck.

01221.name: Face Your Fears
01221.text: Response: When a Ranger performs a test, commit X effort.

01222.name: Biosign Sensor
01222.text: Attach to a feature. Response: After the attached feature is cleared, scout X path cards. X is equal to the number of beings in play.

01223.name: Dendritic Vine
01223.text: Use 1 pulse: When you rest, scout 3 Ranger cards.

01224.name: Clarity of the Headwaters
01224.text: Search your Ranger deck for any number of cards and place them facedown on top of your fatigue stack in the order of your choice.

01225.name: Nal's Understanding
01225.text: Add 5[progress] to a being. Then, if the being hasn't cleared, resolve each of its challenge effects in an order of your choice. Resolve these effects even if the being is exhausted.

01226.name: Hy Pimpot's Secret Recipe
01226.text: Add 1[harm] to each flora. Add X[progress] to each being. Then each ranger soothes X fatigue. X is equal to the total number of [harm] added by this card.

01227.name: Philosopher's Honey
01227.text: Exhaust (use 1 dollop): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of [FOC] in their energy pool.

01228.name: Quisi's Favorite Snack
01228.text: Exhaust (use 1 bite): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of [SPI] in their energy pool.

01229.name: Harvest Crown
01229.text: Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a Connect test that interacts with a human, commit 2 effort.

01231.name: Ranger Badge
01231.text: Attach to your role. Exhaust (use 1 xp): Ready your role.

01240.name: Lingering Injury
01240.text: Fatiguing 2 Response: When you draw this card, attach it to your role. [FIT] + [reason]: Treat [2] and bandage the injury to return this card to your collection.

01262.name: Prowling Wolhund
01262.text: If there is another predator in play, this predator comes into play exhausted.

01263.name: Sitka Buck
01263.text:
[sun]If there is another active Sitka Buck, exhaust this being. [conditional] Add 2[harm] to both this and the other Sitka Buck.
[mountain]If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [conditional] Add 2[harm] to it, then add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.
[crest]If there is an active Sitka Doe, <f>the buck charges.</f> [conditional] Suffer 1 injury.

01264.name: Sitka Doe
01264.text: [spi] + [conflict]: Shoo away the skittish grazer to move this being

01265.name: Caustic Mulcher
01265.text: Beings attached to this being do not ready. If a [ranger] is on this biomeld, you cannot travel and [ranger] on this being cannot be moved except by this test:[FIT] + [conflict]: Wrest [2] them free on the mulcher's grasp to exhaust thi biomeld, then remove a [ranger] or unattach a being from it. If you unattach being, place it in the same area as this biomeld. [sun] If there is another active being, exhaust it and attach it to this biomeld. If not, move your [ranger] to this biomeld. [crest] Add 1[harm] to each being attached to this biomeld. Each Ranger with their [ranger] on this biomeld suffers 1 injury.

01266.name: Sunberry Bramble
01266.text: [AWA] + [reason]: Pluck [2] the thorn-ringedfruit to add 1[harm] to this feature and soothe 2 fatigue. If you fail, this feature fatigues you. [mountain]If there is an active prey, exhaust it [conditional] Add [progress]to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

01267.name: Overgrown Thicket
01267.text: Obstacle. [AWA] + [exploration]: Hunt for a way through the dense foliage to add [progress] to this feature equal to your effort. [mountain]Discard 1[progress] from thi feature. [conditional] It fatigues you.

01268.name: Circling Irix
01268.text: Persistent. [SPI] + [conflict]: Scare [2] off the loitering carrion-eater to place this being on top of the path deck. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. [sun]If this being is along the way, move it within reach. [conditional] It fatigues you. [crest]If this being is within reach, and you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust it. [conditional] Suffer 1 injury.

01269.name: Pouncing Atrox
01269.text:
Ambush.
[sun]If there is another active predator, <f>the atrox pounces.</f> [conditional] Add 2[harm] to that predator and 1[harm] to this being.
[crest]If you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [conditional] Suffer 1 injury.

01270.name: Agitated Meadowlarks
01270.text: [SPI] + [connection]: Listen for the meadowlark's song of warning to move your [ranger] to this being. Response: Before a being moves or enters play within reach, you may remove your [ranger] from this prey to exhaust that being. [mountain]If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [conditional] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

01271.name: Fresh Sitka Carcass
01271.text: [AWA] + [connection]: Watch [2] for opportunistic carnivores to move your [ranger] to this feature. [sun]If your [ranger] is not on this feature, exhaust this feature. [conditional] Search the path deck for the next predator and put it into play. [mountain]If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [conditional] Add [harm] to this feature equal to that predator's presence.

01272.name: Fractalwire
01272.text: Obstacle. [FOC] + [conflict]: Break [2] the bladed coils to add 1[harm] to this feature for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. [mountain]Add 1[harm] to each being within reach.

01273.name: Shale Scree
01273.text: Obstacle. [AWA] + [exploration]: Scramble [2] up the slope of shifting rockes to add 3[progress] to this feature for every 2 effort. If you fail, resolve its [mountain] challenge effect. [mountain]Move this card within reach. [conditional] It fatigues you. Move each being that is within reach to another area. [crest]If this feature is within reach, shuffle it into the path deck. [conditional] Suffer 1 injury.

01274.name: Spiderline Stanchion
01274.text: During your turn, if your [ranger] is on this feature, you may treat obstacles as if they did not have the obstacle keyword. [SPI] + [reason]: Brace [3] yourself for the ride to move your [ranger] to this feature. Response: When you travel, if all [ranger] are on this feature, you may travel to a location up to 2 paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck.

01275.name: Lutrinal Holt
01275.text: [FOC] + [connection]: Coax [2] the lutrinals back to their lair to add 1 lure to this feature. You may discard 1 token from an equipped food to commit 1 effort.
